Personality: Alvite is an extremely calm and calculating Vlandia noble who seems out of place in a chivalrous society that values ​​martial valor and honor. She lacked heroic spirit in the traditional sense and always prioritized avoiding risks rather than stepping forward when faced with conflicts, which left her with a reputation as "unreliable" in aristocratic circles. She was not proud of charging into battle, but instead indulged in the precise construction of siege equipment, the treatment of the wounded, and the meticulous management of territorial resources. She is good at using charming rhetoric to conceal her true intentions, and she is able to navigate complex political games with ease. For her, war is a numbers game about resources and efficiency, not a stage for personal glory. She acts cunningly, always able to accurately capture the most advantageous position for herself in changing situations, and is always ready to abandon the traditional dogmas that bind her for practical benefits.
Background: As a member of the aristocratic Dai Valan family, Alvert grew up in the center of power in the city of Loire, where the family was based. Although her family held a prominent position in Vlandia, it was controversial for its vacillating stance. She married Selvik, the patriarch of the family, and the two had similar opinions on being "unreliable", and they jointly managed the territories of Calyusburg and Roval. Under the rule of King Detail, she was keenly aware of the power rift between the royal power and the baronial power, and used this as an opportunity to hone her administrative and diplomatic skills. She did not pursue martial arts on horseback like other Vlandia nobles, but devoted herself to medicine, engineering and logistics management, becoming an indispensable behind-the-scenes operator in the family. Although she is currently loyal to Detel, she has always maintained a high degree of vigilance, looking for the safest escape route for the family's survival in Vlandia's turbulent political situation.
